raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  build_number: 1
  version: "11.0.3"

  # Computed from tg_ variant (target architecture)
  qemu_user_sysroot: ${{ "powerpc64le" if tg_ == "ppc64le" else tg_ }}
  x_target: ${{ "linux-" ~ ("64" if tg_ == "x86_64" else tg_) }}
  
recipe:
  name: qemu-execve-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.qemu.org/qemu-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: da5fcffc32762820568b828ed430a728864d34d50b6d2f30358597760cbb0523
  target_directory: qemu_source
  patches:
    - patches/base/missing-RESOLVE_CACHED.patch
    - patches/base/0001-linux-user-signal-fixes.patch
    - patches/base/0002-linux-user-syscall-fixes.patch
    - patches/base/configure-host-os-override.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip: not linux or x_target == build_platform or x_target == "linux-64"

outputs:
  # =========================================================================
  # qemu-execve-{arch}: QEMU linux-user with vanilla + execve-patched binaries
  # =========================================================================
  - package:
      name: qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}
    build:
      script:
        file: build.sh
        env:
          CONDA_QEMU_TARGET: "${{ tg_ }}"
      files:
        include:
          - bin/qemu-${{ tg_ }}
          - bin/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}
          - etc/conda/activate.d/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}-activate.sh
          - etc/conda/deactivate.d/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}-deactivate.sh
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: "error"
        overlinking_behavior: "error"
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: build_platform == "linux-64"
            then:
              - ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
          - if: build_platform == "linux-aarch64"
            then:
              - ld-linux-aarch64.so.1
          - libc.so.6
          - libm.so.6
          - libpthread.so.0
          - librt.so.1
          - libdl.so.2
          - libresolv.so.2
          - libutil.so.1
    requirements:
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libslirp
          - if: tg_ != "aarch64"
            then:
              - zlib
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('zig') }}
        - bash >=5.2
        - git
        - meson
        - ninja
        - pip
        - pkg-config
        - python 3.12.*
        # - if: build_platform != host_platform
        #   then:
        #     - cross-python_${{ host_platform }} 3.12.*
        - qemu.qmp ==0.0.5
        - setuptools
        - wheel
      host:
        - if: not riscv64
          then:
            - glib
            - libcapstone
            - libslirp
            - zlib
      run:
        - if: not riscv64
          then:
            - libcapstone
            - libglib
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            - qemu-${{ tg_ }}
            - qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}
          files:
            - etc/conda/activate.d/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}-activate.sh
            - etc/conda/deactivate.d/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}-deactivate.sh
            # Testing artifacts
            - etc/conda/test-files/qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }}/*
      - script:
          - test -n "${QEMU_LD_PREFIX}"
          - test -n "${QEMU_EXECVE}"

          # Vanilla binary tests
          - qemu-${{ tg_ }} --version | grep ${{ version }}

          # Execve binary tests
          - qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }} --version | grep ${{ version }}

          - export QEMU_CPU=${{ "power9" if tg_ == "ppc64le" else "max" }}

          - if: tg_ != "ppc64le" and tg_ != "s390x"
            then:
              - export ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
              - ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-conda-linux-gnu-zig cc -target ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-linux-musl -o hello_from tests/hello_from.c
              - ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-conda-linux-gnu-zig cc -target ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-linux-musl -o execve_call tests/execve_call.c
            else:
              - ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-conda-linux-gnu-gcc -static -o hello_from tests/hello_from.c
              - ${{ qemu_user_sysroot }}-conda-linux-gnu-gcc -static -o execve_call tests/execve_call.c

          # Test 1: Normal execution via vanilla binary
          - qemu-${{ tg_ }} ./hello_from ${{ tg_ }} > output.txt
          - "grep -q ${{ tg_ }} output.txt && { echo 'QEMU vanilla executes binary: OK'; }"

          # Test 2: Normal execution via execve binary
          - qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }} ./hello_from ${{ tg_ }} > output_execve.txt
          - "grep -q ${{ tg_ }} output_execve.txt && { echo 'QEMU execve executes binary: OK'; }"

          # Test 3: execve() without QEMU_EXECVE (should work - runs on host)
          - "QEMU_EXECVE= qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }} ./execve_call /bin/ls > ls_host.txt 2>&1 || true"
          - "grep -q 'hello_from' ls_host.txt && { echo 'execve() calls native ld without QEMU_EXECVE: OK'; }"

          # Test 4: execve() with QEMU_EXECVE (should fail - wrong ELF)
          - qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }} ./execve_call /bin/ls > ls_redirect.txt 2>&1 || true
          - "! grep -q 'hello_from' ls_redirect.txt"
          - "grep -q Invalid ls_redirect.txt && { echo 'Invalid exec for native /bin/ls with EXECVE flag: OK'; }"

          # Test 5: execve() of cross-compiled binary with QEMU_EXECVE
          - qemu-execve-${{ tg_ }} ./execve_call ./hello_from EXECVE > execve_test.txt 2>&1 || true
          - "grep -q 'EXECVE' execve_test.txt && { echo 'execve() calls emulated arch ld with QEMU_EXECVE set: OK'; }"

        requirements:
          run:
            - if: tg_ != "ppc64le" and tg_ != "s390x"
              then:
                - zig_${{ x_target }}
              else:
                - gcc_${{ x_target }}
        files:
          recipe:
            - tests/hello_from.c
            - tests/execve_call.c

about:
  homepage: https://gitlab.com/qemu-project/qemu
  summary: 'QEMU linux-user emulator with execve interception for conda cross-compilation'
  description: |
    Ships two binaries per target architecture:
    - qemu-{arch}: vanilla QEMU linux-user with stability patches
    - qemu-execve-{arch}: adds execve interception for conda cross-compile workflows
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file:
    - qemu_source/LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
